run_log_reports: run the log reports script to parse pytest log files and post test results to Slack
parse_pytest_logs: parse pytest JSON log files to extract failed tests with their durations and outcomes
format_failed_tests_table: format failed test data into a tabulate markdown table grouped by test location
post_slack_report: post a Slack message with nightly test results including failed test summaries and action links
aggregate_test_failures: aggregate test failures across multiple log files and group them by file and class
